verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe a built-in image capability that resizes and converts images on demand and serves them from its CDN in modern formats, which covers every element of the story. The support rests on one short first-party line. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of transformation parameters, supported formats, caching and limits, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN

citations.quote: Resize and convert images on demand and serve them from the CDN in modern formats.
